jobs.title: PMO AI Leader - Client Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology company that leads with outcomes and teams with leaders, bringing more together. Our purpose is to help people and organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Every day we bring our heads and our hearts to being a trusted copilot, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion for each of our customers.
Our strategic vision is to be the first in our industry to lead with bringing more and delivering outcomes as we work to become the world’s most customer-obsessed and employee-empowered services company. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Who You'll Work With

Our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We connect across all technical and advisory capabilities, bringing strategy to life through delivery execution that is rigorous, adaptive and outcome driven. 
You'll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about helping clients solve their toughest business and technology challenges. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it is a multi-workstream delivery or PMO transformation, we bring clarity, structure and momentum to every engagement. 
We work in-person with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are, whether Agile, Waterfall, hybrid or product-based. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows.
As a Delivery Leader focused on AI-enabled client delivery, you will be a consulting leader who assesses how clients deliver projects and products, designs fit-for-purpose PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, and leads the creation and adoption of practical AI agents and accelerators. You will combine program leadership, product delivery, governance, change enablement, and hands-on solution shaping to move clients from current-state assessment through pilot execution, measurable value realization, and responsilbe scale. 

Job Title:

PMO AI Leader - Client Delivery

What You’ll Do

L ead the successful delivery of projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, change control, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.

I ndependently establish program governance, executive reporting, integrated plans, decision frameworks, delivery health reviews, quality gates, and escalation practices that enable timely decisions and predictable execution.

O wn engagement and account financials, including margin, staffing, forecasting, managed revenue, utilization, and profitability.

B uild strategic client relationships, strengthen Slalom's trusted advisor position, and identify opportunities to expand AI-enabled Delivery, Product, Data, Change, and Technology capabilities.

L ead AI-enabled PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, and product delivery maturity assessments across strategy, governance, processes, tools, team structure, skills, data readiness, automation, adoption, and value measurement.

C onduct stakeholder interviews, working sessions, artifact reviews, workflow analysis, and capability assessments to identify delivery gaps, bottlenecks, compliance considerations, and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

Translate assessment findings into prioritized opportunity heatmaps, baseline metrics, business cases, target operating models, implementation roadmaps, and recommendations for pilot and enterprise-scale adoption.
Define fit-for-purpose delivery frameworks that combine Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, product-based, and AI-enabled practices while meeting client governance, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements.
Design PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, including governance forums, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, delivery standards, stage gates, escalation paths, metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Design, configure, and help build AI agents and agentic workflows by defining business outcomes, context, instructions, tools, data sources, rules, thresholds, human approval points, exception handling, and evaluation criteria.
Provide hands-on coaching to Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams as they adopt new delivery practices, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving human-and-agent responsibilities.
Champion Delivery Excellence by creating repeatable frameworks, governance standards, quality practices, metrics, accelerators, and reusable assets across engagements.
Coach consultants providing feedback while contributing to capability development, and knowledge sharing.
Maintain 85%+ personal utilization while supporting team utilization, capability health, and broader market priorities.

What You’ll Bring

8 + years of consulting experience leading business and technology transformation initiatives within a client-facing professional services or consulting environment.

P roven experience leading PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, product delivery, SDLC, or AI-PDLC maturity and readiness assessments and translating findings into operating models, roadmaps, pilots, and measurable improvement plans.

D emonstrated ability to assess end-to-end delivery processes, team capabilities, governance, tooling, data readiness, automation, change impacts, and organizational readiness through interviews, workshops, artifact reviews, and workflow analysis.

H ands-on experience identifying, designing, configuring, prototyping, or delivering enterprise AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, or AI-enabled delivery accelerators.

W orking knowledge of large language models, context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, APIs and integrations, knowledge repositories, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Experience moving AI solutions from use-case discovery and prioritization through prototype, pilot, validation, deployment readiness, adoption, value measurement, and responsible scale.
Strong understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, model and agent risk, data governance, access controls, auditability, compliance, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Ability to define practical success measures and business cases for AI-enabled delivery, including improvements to cycle time, quality, forecasting, risk identification, administrative effort, adoption, and value realization.
Expertise in Agile, Waterfall, SAFe, hybrid, and product-based delivery models, with the judgment to tailor methods to client needs, maturity, risk, and regulatory context.
Demonstrated success managing engagement budgets, staffing, contractual commitments, forecasting, margin, utilization, profitability, and delivery quality.
Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, consulting, and leadership skills, with the ability to connect business, product, delivery, data, change, and technology stakeholders through complexity and ambiguity.
A growth mindset, and commitment to continuous learning, responsible innovation, delivery excellence, and Slalom's values.

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Hybrid/In office:
We are hybrid but there are expectations that if your team leader or client requires you onsite that you are able to meet those expectations/requirements

Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this position, the expected base salary pay range is $135,000 to $160,000. In addition, there is potential for a 15% discretionary bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation will depend upon individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

Slalom Employee Perks:

Culture & fun!
Lunch & learns
Health & wellness activities
Holiday parties
Employee community groups
Social clubs & activities
Vacation (20 days prorated based on start date & wellness/sick days)

Tangible perks

Competitive compensation package

Registered Retirement Program (RRSP) & Employer Matching
Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA)
Annual “Thrive Well-Being” Gift Card
Family planning/ Fertility Benefit
Maternity/Parental Leave Top-Up
Medical & Dental Benefits

Access to Supplementary Life and AD&D Insurance
Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Inkblot Therapy
And more!

*All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements

Slalom is an inclusive, equal opportunity employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will work to reasonably accommodate applicants’ needs throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Director, People and Culture Strategy

Employment Type

Permanent

Existing Vacancy

Yes

Division/Branch

People and Culture Division / People and Culture Strategy

Application Deadline

October 9, 2026

Pay Level

13

Pay Range

$149,307 to $186,631

Work Location:

Head Office, Toronto, ON; (In-Office)

The Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO)
is an agency where innovation thrives, ideas flourish, and passion drives us to new heights of excellence. Reporting to the Ministry of the Attorney General, the AGCO is responsible for regulating Ontario’s vibrant alcohol, gaming, horse racing, and private retail cannabis sectors in accordance with the principles of honesty and integrity, and in the public interest.

The Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) is seeking a strategic, collaborative and forward-thinking leader to serve as Director, People and Culture Strategy. Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Director People and Culture Strategy provides enterprise leadership for People and Culture strategy, transformation and modernization, with responsibility for advancing the People Strategic Plan, divisional priorities, enterprise metrics and executive reporting, HR digital enablement, responsible AI adoption, diversity, inclusion and accessibility (DI&A), inclusive leadership and high-performing team leadership.

This role translates enterprise and divisional priorities into practical strategies, roadmaps, implementation plans, performance measures and governance mechanisms that strengthen organizational readiness, workforce planning, evidence-based decision-making and measurable impact across AGCO.

The ideal candidate is a trusted strategic advisor who brings strong judgment, systems thinking and a collaborative leadership style. They are comfortable operating in a complex public-sector environment, balancing long-term transformation with immediate operational priorities, and translating data, risk, workforce trends and stakeholder needs into practical, inclusive and measurable people strategies.

If you are motivated by the opportunity to lead strategic HR transformation, advance responsible digital and AI adoption, strengthen diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and support a strong employee experience, this role offers a meaningful platform to make a lasting enterprise-wide contribution at AGCO.

What You Will Do

Lead the development, implementation and ongoing refresh of AGCO’s People Strategic Plan, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, government mandates, workforce risks and evolving organizational needs.
Translate organizational priorities into actionable people strategies, roadmaps, initiatives, performance measures and implementation plans.
Oversee the planning, prioritization and delivery of People and Culture initiatives, projects and divisional priorities that advance organizational goals.
Establish planning, governance, reporting and accountability mechanisms to monitor progress against strategic commitments and demonstrate measurable impact.
Provide strategic advice to the CHRO, C-Suite, senior leaders and governance committees on HR priorities, workforce implications, transformation risks and organizational readiness.
Design and oversee enterprise People and Culture performance indicators, dashboards, workforce analytics and executive reporting to support transparency, accountability and evidence-informed decision-making.
Lead HR digital enablement and responsible AI adoption by developing practical capability, governance practices and high-value use cases that improve service quality, efficiency and decision-making.
Provide enterprise leadership for DI&A strategy, accessibility and inclusive leadership, embedding inclusion principles into AGCO culture, operations and people practices.
Lead the refresh, implementation and evaluation of enterprise DI&A strategy, including the development and reporting of meaningful performance measures.
Act as a senior subject matter expert on DI&A and accessibility, advising executives and senior leaders on inclusive talent practices, cultural transformation and emerging obligations.
Provide leadership and direction to a team by setting clear expectations, prioritizing deliverables, supporting development and fostering a culture of inclusion, accountability, learning and high

You Have

Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Organizational Psychology, Adult Education, Strategic Planning, Leadership, Human Rights, Public Policy or a related field, or equivalent work experience; a master’s degree is considered an asset.
Minimum of 8 years progressive leadership experience in strategic planning, organizational transformation, HR strategy, performance measurement, workforce analytics, DI&A, accessibility, digital enablement and/or related areas.
Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise priorities into practical strategies, roadmaps, governance structures, implementation plans and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of HR digital adoption, HRIS-enabled process improvement, workflow automation, workforce analytics, digital service delivery, change management and responsible AI use.
Knowledge of HR data governance, privacy, accessibility, security, records management and ethical use of workforce information.
Experience developing executive-level reports, dashboards, briefings and presentations that translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations.
Strong consultation, facilitation, public speaking and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment across senior leaders, governance bodies and cross-functional partners.
Demonstrated experience leading DI&A strategy, accessibility initiatives, inclusive leadership development, employee engagement forums, committees or enterprise-wide measurement frameworks.
Strong knowledge of Ontario legal and regulatory frameworks related to human rights, accessibility, employment standards and inclusive workplace practices.
Experience leading, coaching and developing teams in a complex, unionized and public-sector environment is an asset.
Eligibility to work in Canada and the ability to successfully complete a criminal background check.

To apply to this vacancy, please submit your application online at our Careers webpage located at Careers | Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario. Please note that only applications submitted through the Applicant Tracking System will be accepted.

About The AGCO

The Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) is an Ontario provincial regulatory agency that reports to the Ministry of the Attorney General. We are responsible for regulating the alcohol, gaming, horse racing and cannabis retail sectors in accordance with the principles of honesty and integrity, and in the public interest.

The AGCO is proud to be recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for the second year in a row. This annual distinction reflects our commitment to cultivating a workplace environment that prioritizes employee well-being, emphasizing work-life balance, mental health resources, and opportunities for professional growth. We remain committed to fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment for our employees.

What We Offer

The AGCO provides a comprehensive range of benefits and programs (subject to eligibility), including:

Generous time-off policy, including 2 volunteer days to contribute to causes that matter to you.
Defined benefit pension plans to secure your financial future.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid premiums.
Well-being credits to support gym memberships, therapy, financial planning, and more.
Employer-paid parental leave top-up.
Professional development opportunities with access to training programs, leadership resources, and reimbursement for professional memberships.
24/7 confidential support through our Employee Assistance Program.
Convenient, central location near the subway line for easy access when working in the office. Paid onsite parking is also available.

Please note that only applications submitted through the Applicant Tracking System will be accepted.

The AGCO is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer.

The AGCO has the responsibility to lead by example in advancing racial equity and to build a diverse, inclusive, accessible and respectful workplace where every employee has a voice and the opportunity to fully contribute. To this effect, you are encouraged to reflect upon the diversity you would bring to the role within your application including, but not limited to, individuals identifying with one or more of the under-represented groups identified within Ontario’s Human Rights Code. 

Disability related accommodation during the recruitment process is available upon request. Persons with disabilities who require accommodation during the application process, or who need job postings in an alternative format, may email their request to askhr@agco.ca. The subject line should read “Accommodation in Application – [Position Title].

We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of the hiring process. All applications will be reviewed and evaluated by our Human Resources team and hiring managers.

jobs.title: Vice President, Portfolio Analytics
jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

A challenging and exciting role in a rapidly growing industry, Portfolio Analytics services across a diverse client base spanning hedge funds, private markets and multi-asset strategies across North America, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia. The Vice President of the Portfolio Analytics group will take a senior leadership role managing existing US client relationships, ensuring client retention, and driving sales, marketing and business development initiatives across the region. The team provides ad-hoc and regulatory risk reports that include, but are not limited to, exposure and P&L reports, limits monitoring, scenario analysis, stress testing, value-at-risk and fund performance analytics - supporting clients across a broad range of strategies and structures.

The role provides a unique opportunity to work closely with a wide range of securities, derivatives and structured products in many currencies traded across global markets, and to lead the build-out of a structured, high-performing client service model across the US book. The individual's duties will include, but are not limited to, client onboarding project management, senior client relationship leadership, team management, and the training and development of staff — mirroring and helping to embed a proven operating model already established elsewhere in the group.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Business Development & Commercial Acumen — Take an active, leading role in the CFS 'new business acquisition' process from a Portfolio Analytics perspective, effectively demonstrating our suite of Portfolio Analytics services to potential clients as well as new or enhanced services to existing clients, positioning this as a core driver of the role; evaluate the viability of current and new business proposals with emphasis on tactical issues and barriers
Client Relationship Management — Own and lead senior client relationships across the US book, participating in regular client calls and working closely with the global Client Integration team who oversee and project manage the firm-wide onboarding process
Reporting of Client KPIs — Own and maintain the KPI and RAG framework across the US client base, supervising junior team members in day-to-day tracking and reporting to support senior management oversight
Team Leadership & Management — Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the US Portfolio Analytics team, embedding a structured, KPI-driven client service model and ensuring consistent standards of client oversight and RAG reporting across the book
Communication — Use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance and help others understand the importance of the vision on the day-to-day reality of the risk reporting process
Building Networks - Proactively build strong relationships with Client Service and Business Development colleagues across CFS offices as a first priority, while also networking across departments (Valuation/Profit & Loss, Operations, Internal Audit, Integration, etc.) to establish collaborative business relationships at all levels and facilitate the accomplishment of business objectives
Leading & Managing Others — Embody the CFS culture, lead and inspire team through change, encourage others to seek opportunities for different approaches to address problems and opportunities
Organization & Resource Management — Oversee the US team with responsibility for pre-sales, onboarding, client coverage planning, and other new business initiatives
Building and Retaining Organizational Talent —Focus on identifying, developing, deploying and retaining key talent within the US team (including succession planning) for the future success of CFS, initiating strategies to develop internal talent through ongoing training and conducting timely performance evaluations.
Operational Decision-making — Commit and take responsibility for tactical decisions, adopting innovative approaches to move resolution of challenges to completion; communicate outcomes to all stakeholders and contribute to CFS vision and strategy
Execution — Execute business strategy by aligning communication, accountabilities, skills, internal processes and measurement to ensure sustainable and profitable results
Client Risk & Continuity Oversight — Identify and manage clients with elevated customisation and key person risk, ensuring documented continuity plans are in place and escalating concentration risk where appropriate

Qualifications

About You:

Drive for Results — Possessing an energetic and tenacious achievement orientation; proactively seeking opportunities to drive performance of self and team, and setting stretching goals; managing personal and group strengths and opportunities
Navigating Complexity — Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues where ambiguity exists; communicating complicated information concisely and logically
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to summarise and interpret client requirements
Aspiration to become a subject matter expert in proprietary risk solutions
Someone who enjoys project-based work, collaboration across teams, and dealing directly with clients — no two days the same
Quantitative background with a Bachelor's/higher level degree or professional qualification (MSc, PhD, CQF, FRM, PRMIA, GARP, CFA, FIA)
Proficient in Excel, VBA, SQL, with Python experience in particular advantageous
Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Qlik Sense (or Tableau) and Jaspersoft is a plus
7–10 years' experience in investment and regulatory risk reporting and performance analytics in funds/asset management/banking/insurance - including hedge fund, private markets and multi-asset strategies , with demonstrated experience in client relationship leadership, team management, pre-sales, onboarding and business development
Prior experience managing or supervising a client-facing team is required
Knowledge of market, credit, liquidity and counterparty risk measurement and management under regulatory frameworks such as Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Annex IV, Basel III/CRD IV/CRR and Solvency II is advantageous
Candidates must be willing to travel to the United States for business purposes

Salary Range:
$115,000 - 155,000

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, short and long-term disability benefits, a retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, mental health and wellness support, parental leave, and more. Additional details about our total rewards package will be shared during the hiring process.

At Citco, we take pride in fostering an inclusive culture by prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation, mutual respect, and collaboration. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. If you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer, Citco adheres to making all employment and personnel decisions without discriminating based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, physical disability, mental disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national or ethnic origin, or any other protected status. We believe that an inclusive workforce not only enriches our company but also drives us towards greater success.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Our employees may perform other job-related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of our organization.

jobs.description:
Req Id:
432862

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell's AI Fabric initiative is building Canada's largest sovereign AI infrastructure platform, comprising seven large-scale, high-density data centres across the country, including a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2 GW flagship campus in Regina, Saskatchewan.

Reporting to the VP, Capital Programs, the Director, Engineering & Procurement is responsible for providing leadership across engineering governance, technical strategy, strategic sourcing, procurement, and supplier management for Bell's national AI Fabric portfolio. This role will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams while overseeing the procurement of mission-critical infrastructure, ensuring Bell secures and delivers the power, cooling, electrical, mechanical, network, and modular systems required to support hyperscale AI operations. Working closely with Construction, Program Controls, Commissioning, Operations, Finance, Legal, and external partners, the Director will drive engineering excellence, commercial value, supply chain resilience, and successful project execution across a multi-billion-dollar capital program.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the engineering and procurement functions supporting Bell AI Fabric developments across multiple Canadian sites.
Establish engineering standards, technical specifications, design governance processes, and quality assurance frameworks for mission-critical infrastructure.
Oversee engineering reviews and approvals for power distribution, utility interconnections, backup generation, UPS systems, cooling infrastructure, liquid cooling technologies, controls, and related systems.
Develop and execute procurement strategies for major capital equipment, engineering services, and long-lead infrastructure components required for AI data centre development.
Lead supplier selection, commercial negotiations, contract management, and strategic partnerships with OEMs, engineering firms, utilities, EPC contractors, and technology vendors.
Drive capacity planning, infrastructure resiliency, technology roadmaps, and technical risk mitigation strategies supporting high-density AI and GPU workloads.
Partner with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and Program Controls teams to ensure engineering and procurement activities align with project schedules, budgets, and operational requirements.
Manage supply chain risks, supplier performance, cost optimization initiatives, and procurement governance across the portfolio.
Provide executive-level recommendations regarding infrastructure investments, commercial strategies, engineering risks, and project delivery performance.
Develop and lead a high-performing team while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Critical Qualifications

12+ years of progressive leadership experience in engineering, procurement, construction, mission-critical facilities, data centres, energy infrastructure, or large-scale capital programs.
5+ years of people leadership experience managing engineering, procurement, project delivery, or integrated infrastructure teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale data centres, mission-critical facilities, utility infrastructure, or large-scale industrial construction projects.
Strong technical expertise in electrical distribution systems, cooling infrastructure, liquid cooling technologies, resiliency design, and mission-critical operations.
Proven success leading strategic sourcing initiatives, complex commercial negotiations, and major procurement programs.
Deep understanding of engineering governance, capital project delivery, EPC contracting models, procurement practices, and commissioning processes.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, business case development, and contract administration.
Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Construction Engineering, or a related technical discipline; P.Eng. designation strongly preferred.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and travel as required to support projects across Canada.

About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to servicing all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So, for those who want to play at the top of their game and be the vanguard of their space, we say welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

The Transformation Office strives to create a consistent ability to standardize and optimize our organization at all times. By bringing together subject matter expertise across process, platform and line of business, we provide clear direction and governance to change, positioning CFS to continually evolve & scale to the changing market dynamics, to our business demands and to our client needs.

Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. Our global Centers of Excellence are home to some of the most accomplished professionals in the sector, providing best-in-class client support and unparalleled opportunities for learning, development and career progression.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Support transformation initiatives across investor relations, transfer agency, AML, and KYC, helping to drive process optimization & operational efficiency
Support senior management in the delivery of client transformation engagements in collaboration with client stakeholders and the wider Citco business (SMEs and Business Leads) translating agreed objectives into practical implementation plans
Support the VP/SVP in overseeing a dedicated client engagement, working directly with client stakeholders to understand priorities, manage day-to-day expectations, coordinate delivery, and escalate key risks and decisions as appropriate
Identify opportunities that can be used (e.g. automation, standardization, simplification, and integration) to solve business obstacles and to improve existing business processes
Provide subject matter expertise around investor relations and/or AML/KYC
Work closely with Business Analysts and broader project and business teams to guide, teach and impart specialized knowledge
Assist with business requirements sign-off, testing, and development sign-off for initiatives in your specialized area
Work directly with Business Development to play an active role in client pitches by effectively demonstrating and communicating Transformation Office’s expertise, best practices and technological solutions
Maintain a proactive approach to staying up-to-date on industry changes and technology advancements
Highlight areas of risk, contributing to meetings and overall project reporting via project manager
Lead and mentor junior team members to foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the Transformation Office
Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, analytical, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex operational issues clearly and influence outcomes across business and project teams

Qualifications

About You:

6-8 years relevant industry experience within Investor Relations, AML, KYC or Compliance, including hands-on experience delivering operational improvement or transformation initiatives
Strong client-facing experience, with the confidence to engage directly with senior stakeholders, manage day-to-day relationships and take ownership of agreed delivery and service outcomes within the roles remit
Professional Certificate, Bachelor, Master level degree
A transformation mindset, with experience challenging established processes and implementing technology-enabled improvements
Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into actionable plans
In-depth knowledge of compliance and regulatory issues including Know Your Customer (KYC) and anti-money laundering policies; Cayman AML an advantage
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a leadership role and managing teams remotely

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Director, MEP & Electrical Infrastructure, you will provide strategic leadership for the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, power generation, and utility infrastructure programs that underpin Bell AI Fabric's national data centre platform. This role combines portfolio-level MEP governance with ownership of the electrical infrastructure ecosystem, including power generation, transmission interconnections, substations, distribution networks, backup power systems, and high-density cooling infrastructure.

You will establish the standards, delivery frameworks, procurement strategies, and technical governance that every site inherits and executes against. Working across engineering, construction, utilities, regulators, OEMs, and executive leadership, you will ensure the AI Fabric portfolio delivers scalable, resilient, and mission-critical infrastructure capable of supporting Canada's next generation of AI compute capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Strategy

Own the enterprise-wide MEP and Electrical Infrastructure strategy across Bell AI Fabric's national data centre portfolio.
Establish standardized design bases, engineering specifications, technical standards, governance frameworks, and delivery playbooks across all sites.
Drive consistency, repeatability, scalability, and continuous improvement across multiple concurrent data centre developments.
Build and scale the MEP and Electrical Infrastructure leadership function as the program expands nationally.

Electrical Infrastructure & Energy Systems

Lead planning and execution of major electrical infrastructure programs supporting large-scale AI and data centre operations.
Establish technical requirements and design standards for HV and MV electrical systems, substations, switchyards, distribution networks, and critical power systems.
Oversee development of gas-fired generation assets, utility interconnections, backup power systems, and grid-connected energy infrastructure.
Lead utility negotiations, transmission access discussions, capacity planning, and interconnection agreements.
Develop long-term energy strategies to support portfolio growth while ensuring reliability, resilience, and operational continuity.
Evaluate and integrate emerging energy technologies including battery energy storage systems (BESS), microgrids, distributed generation, and grid modernization solutions.

MEP Engineering & Infrastructure Delivery

Define and govern MEP standards for power distribution, UPS systems, generators, cooling plants, chilled water systems, controls, and high-density/liquid cooling technologies.
Lead portfolio-wide modularization and prefabrication strategies to improve schedule certainty, quality, and scalability across sites.
Provide technical oversight and governance to site-level engineering, MEP, and construction leaders.
Ensure lessons learned, best practices, and engineering innovations are captured and implemented portfolio-wide.

Manage relationships with regulators, utilities, EPC contractors, consultants, technology providers, and executive stakeholders.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on infrastructure strategy, energy planning, engineering governance, and program execution.
Influence and align multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Procurement, Program Controls, Asset Management, Construction, Operations, and AI Fabric leadership.

Critical Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related Engineering discipline.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation strongly preferred.
PMP, PgMP, commissioning certification (CxA, ACG), or equivalent professional credential considered an asset.
15+ years of leadership experience delivering large-scale MEP, electrical infrastructure, energy, industrial, mission-critical, or hyperscale data centre programs.
Demonstrated success leading portfolio-level engineering, infrastructure, or capital programs valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars.
Significant experience supporting gas-fired generation facilities and large-scale energy infrastructure.
Proven experience establishing technical standards, governance frameworks, and delivery playbooks across multiple facilities or programs.
Experience developing and scaling modular or off-site construction strategies for mission-critical infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of commissioning methodologies, FAT/SAT processes, integrated systems testing, and operational readiness programs.
Experience leading utility negotiations, transmission access discussions, and regulatory engagement.
Strong command of program cost management, forecasting, and integrated scheduling tools such as Primavera P6.
Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders, technical stakeholders, utilities, regulators, and industry partners.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology company that leads with outcomes and teams with leaders, bringing more together. Our purpose is to help people and organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Every day we bring our heads and our hearts to being a trusted copilot, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion for each of our customers.
Our strategic vision is to be the first in our industry to lead with bringing more and delivering outcomes as we work to become the world’s most customer-obsessed and employee-empowered services company. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Who You'll Work With

Our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We connect across all technical and advisory capabilities, bringing strategy to life through delivery execution that is rigorous, adaptive and outcome driven. 
You'll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about helping clients solve their toughest business and technology challenges. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it is a multi-workstream delivery or PMO transformation, we bring clarity, structure and momentum to every engagement. 
We work in-person with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are, whether Agile, Waterfall, hybrid or product-based. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows.
As a Delivery Leader focused on AI-enabled client delivery, you will be a consulting leader who assesses how clients deliver projects and products, designs fit-for-purpose PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, and leads the creation and adoption of practical AI agents and accelerators. You will combine program leadership, product delivery, governance, change enablement, and hands-on solution shaping to move clients from current-state assessment through pilot execution, measurable value realization, and responsilbe scale. 

Job Title:

PMO AI Leader - Client Delivery

What You’ll Do

L ead the successful delivery of projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, change control, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.

I ndependently establish program governance, executive reporting, integrated plans, decision frameworks, delivery health reviews, quality gates, and escalation practices that enable timely decisions and predictable execution.

O wn engagement and account financials, including margin, staffing, forecasting, managed revenue, utilization, and profitability.

B uild strategic client relationships, strengthen Slalom's trusted advisor position, and identify opportunities to expand AI-enabled Delivery, Product, Data, Change, and Technology capabilities.

L ead AI-enabled PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, and product delivery maturity assessments across strategy, governance, processes, tools, team structure, skills, data readiness, automation, adoption, and value measurement.

C onduct stakeholder interviews, working sessions, artifact reviews, workflow analysis, and capability assessments to identify delivery gaps, bottlenecks, compliance considerations, and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

Translate assessment findings into prioritized opportunity heatmaps, baseline metrics, business cases, target operating models, implementation roadmaps, and recommendations for pilot and enterprise-scale adoption.
Define fit-for-purpose delivery frameworks that combine Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, product-based, and AI-enabled practices while meeting client governance, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements.
Design PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, including governance forums, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, delivery standards, stage gates, escalation paths, metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Design, configure, and help build AI agents and agentic workflows by defining business outcomes, context, instructions, tools, data sources, rules, thresholds, human approval points, exception handling, and evaluation criteria.
Provide hands-on coaching to Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams as they adopt new delivery practices, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving human-and-agent responsibilities.
Champion Delivery Excellence by creating repeatable frameworks, governance standards, quality practices, metrics, accelerators, and reusable assets across engagements.
Coach consultants providing feedback while contributing to capability development, and knowledge sharing.
Maintain 85%+ personal utilization while supporting team utilization, capability health, and broader market priorities.

What You’ll Bring

8 + years of consulting experience leading business and technology transformation initiatives within a client-facing professional services or consulting environment.

P roven experience leading PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, product delivery, SDLC, or AI-PDLC maturity and readiness assessments and translating findings into operating models, roadmaps, pilots, and measurable improvement plans.

D emonstrated ability to assess end-to-end delivery processes, team capabilities, governance, tooling, data readiness, automation, change impacts, and organizational readiness through interviews, workshops, artifact reviews, and workflow analysis.

H ands-on experience identifying, designing, configuring, prototyping, or delivering enterprise AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, or AI-enabled delivery accelerators.

W orking knowledge of large language models, context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, APIs and integrations, knowledge repositories, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Experience moving AI solutions from use-case discovery and prioritization through prototype, pilot, validation, deployment readiness, adoption, value measurement, and responsible scale.
Strong understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, model and agent risk, data governance, access controls, auditability, compliance, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Ability to define practical success measures and business cases for AI-enabled delivery, including improvements to cycle time, quality, forecasting, risk identification, administrative effort, adoption, and value realization.
Expertise in Agile, Waterfall, SAFe, hybrid, and product-based delivery models, with the judgment to tailor methods to client needs, maturity, risk, and regulatory context.
Demonstrated success managing engagement budgets, staffing, contractual commitments, forecasting, margin, utilization, profitability, and delivery quality.
Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, consulting, and leadership skills, with the ability to connect business, product, delivery, data, change, and technology stakeholders through complexity and ambiguity.
A growth mindset, and commitment to continuous learning, responsible innovation, delivery excellence, and Slalom's values.

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.
